title: GRAFT-Net: Graph Retrieval-Augmented Network for Textual and Knowledge Base Question Answering
notes: Graph expansion and graph-based evidence composition.

title: PullNet: Open Domain Question Answering with Iterative Retrieval on Knowledge Bases and Text
notes: Iteratively expands a question-specific graph.

title: Multi-hop Reading Comprehension through Question Decomposition and Rescoring
notes: Decomposes compositional questions into simpler subquestions and globally rescores decompositions.

title: Dynamically Fused Graph Network for Multi-hop Reasoning
notes: Builds and traverses an entity graph over scattered text evidence.

title: Learning to Retrieve Reasoning Paths over Wikipedia Graph for Question Answering
notes: Sequentially retrieves evidence paragraphs conditioned on earlier hops.

title: Unsupervised Question Decomposition for Question Answering
notes: Learns one-to-many decomposition without manually labeled decompositions and recomposes subanswers.

title: Scalable Multi-Hop Relational Reasoning for Knowledge-Aware Question Answering
notes: Performs multi-hop relational reasoning over extracted knowledge-graph subgraphs.

title: Hierarchical Graph Network for Multi-hop Question Answering
notes: Represents question paragraphs sentences and entities at multiple graph granularities.

title: Leveraging Passage Retrieval with Generative Models for Open Domain Question Answering
notes: Fusion-in-decoder reader over retrieved passages.

title: Answering Complex Open-Domain Questions with Multi-Hop Dense Retrieval
notes: Dense retriever conditions each hop on previously retrieved evidence without requiring corpus-specific links.

title: Baleen: Robust Multi-Hop Reasoning at Scale via Condensed Retrieval
notes: Condenses retrieved evidence between hops to control search and context growth.

title: Decomposing Complex Questions Makes Multi-Hop QA Easier and More Interpretable
notes: Uses relation extraction reader and comparison stages to form a decomposed evidence path.

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
notes: Interleaves natural-language reasoning traces with environment actions such as Wikipedia lookup; primary target follows the earliest active retrieval event.

title: Interleaving Retrieval with Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Knowledge-Intensive Multi-Step Questions
notes: Interleaves generated reasoning with retrieval.

title: Active Retrieval Augmented Generation
notes: Retrieval is triggered by generation uncertainty; verify the precise multi-hop scope before using it for a focused comparison.

title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve Generate and Critique through Self-Reflection
notes: Joint retrieval generation and critique policy; primary target follows the earliest active retrieval event.

title: RAPTOR: Recursive Abstractive Processing for Tree-Organized Retrieval
notes: Changes retrieval granularity and context organization.

title: Corrective Retrieval Augmented Generation
notes: Evaluates retrieved context and may trigger web search plus decomposition and recomposition.

title: Adaptive-RAG: Learning to Adapt Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models through Question Complexity
notes: Selects no-retrieval single-step or iterative retrieval strategies from predicted query complexity; primary target follows the earliest active retrieval event.

title: End-to-End Beam Retrieval for Multi-Hop Question Answering
notes: Maintains multiple partial evidence hypotheses to reduce early-hop search errors.

title: From Local to Global: A Graph RAG Approach to Query-Focused Summarization
notes: Builds an entity graph and community summaries to expose local and global corpus evidence.

title: HippoRAG: Neurobiologically Inspired Long-Term Memory for Large Language Models
notes: Uses a graph-based memory index and personalized PageRank for efficient multi-hop retrieval.

title: EfficientRAG: Efficient Retriever for Multi-Hop Question Answering
notes: Decomposes a multi-hop question while pruning irrelevant subquestions and documents during retrieval.

title: Is ChatGPT Good at Search? Investigating Large Language Models as Re-Ranking Agents
notes: Introduces listwise LLM reranking; included as a foundational selector used in multi-hop RAG comparisons.

title: RankZephyr: Effective and Robust Zero-Shot Listwise Reranking is a Breeze!
notes: Open listwise reranker with order and candidate-count robustness checks.

title: Fine-Tuning LLaMA for Multi-Stage Text Retrieval
notes: Studies an LLM retriever and pointwise reranker; the audit codes the reranking intervention.

title: RECOMP: Improving Retrieval-Augmented LMs with Context Compression and Selective Augmentation
notes: Compresses retrieved context and selectively suppresses augmentation when it is not useful.

title: LLMLingua-2: Data Distillation for Efficient and Faithful Task-Agnostic Prompt Compression
notes: Token-level compression under an explicit budget; downstream answer preservation is not coded as causal faithfulness.

title: RankRAG: Unifying Context Ranking with Retrieval-Augmented Generation in LLMs
notes: Jointly instruction-tunes context ranking and answer generation; primary target is candidate preservation.

title: Shifting from Ranking to Set Selection for Retrieval Augmented Generation
notes: Selects a complementary passage set against explicit information requirements rather than scoring passages independently.

title: Aligning Retrieval with Reader Needs: Reader-Centered Passage Selection for Open-Domain Question Answering
notes: Reranks and clusters passages using reader predictions; answer-distribution clustering can couple selection and reader behavior.

title: PRCA: Fitting Black-Box Large Language Models for Retrieval Question Answering via Pluggable Reward-Driven Contextual Adapter
notes: Refines retrieved information between retriever and generator with a reward-driven contextual adapter.

title: Found in the Middle: Calibrating Positional Attention Bias Improves Long Context Utilization
notes: Calibrates position-biased attention so relevant middle context remains accessible.

title: Long-Context LLMs Meet RAG: Overcoming Challenges for Long Inputs in RAG
notes: Studies placement and retrieval ordering under long inputs; fixed-set ordering effects are coded separately from membership.

title: xRAG: Extreme Context Compression for Retrieval-Augmented Generation with One Token
notes: Maps a retrieved document embedding into one language-model token; primary target is context exposure under an extreme token budget.

title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
notes: Controlled analysis that varies the location of relevant information while holding content fixed.

title: KG-FiD: Infusing Knowledge Graph in Fusion-in-Decoder for Open-Domain Question Answering
notes: Injects graph structure into passage filtering and Fusion-in-Decoder; fusion is coded primary for the reviewed mechanism.

title: ReaRev: Adaptive Reasoning for Question Answering over Knowledge Graphs
notes: Uses reason-and-revise instruction execution over a question-specific graph.

title: Improving Multi-hop Knowledge Base Question Answering by Learning Intermediate Supervision Signals
notes: Teacher-student intermediate supervision stabilizes multi-hop graph reasoning.

title: GreaseLM: Graph Reasoning Enhanced Language Models for Question Answering
notes: Couples graph propagation with language-model representations for cross-evidence composition.

title: RARR: Researching and Revising What Language Models Say, Using Language Models
notes: Retrieves evidence and revises generated text while preserving as much original content as possible.

title: Verify-and-Edit: A Knowledge-Enhanced Chain-of-Thought Framework
notes: Verifies factual claims in a reasoning chain with retrieved knowledge before editing.

title: Enabling Large Language Models to Generate Text with Citations
notes: Defines automatic citation correctness and completeness evaluation; citation overlap is not treated as causal evidence use.

title: CofCA: A Step-Wise Counterfactual Multi-hop QA Benchmark
notes: Uses factual and counterfactual multi-step items to test whether answers and intermediate chains follow supplied evidence.

title: Self-Checker: Plug-and-Play Modules for Fact-Checking with Large Language Models
notes: Decomposes generated text into claims and retrieves evidence for verification.

title: CRITIC: Large Language Models Can Self-Correct with Tool-Interactive Critiquing
notes: Uses external tools to critique and revise model outputs; tool feedback is distinguished from causal deletion tests.

title: Beyond Correctness: Rewarding Faithful Reasoning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
notes: Introduces information-think think-answer and think-search faithfulness rewards for search agents.

title: Search-R1: Training LLMs to Reason and Leverage Search Engines with Reinforcement Learning
notes: Trains multi-turn reasoning and search with reinforcement learning; primary target is evidence acquisition.

title: DeepRAG: Thinking to Retrieve Step by Step for Large Language Models
notes: Learns a retrieve-or-reason policy; included through one discretionary recency slot.

title: RAG-Gym: Optimizing Reasoning and Search Agents with Process Supervision
notes: Optimizes search trajectories with process supervision; included through one discretionary process-supervision slot.
